title: ASE Technology Holding Co., Ltd. (NYSE: ASX) — Institutional Underwriting Dossier
archetype: Cyclical Scale Leader in Stage 4 Markdown & Peak CapEx Burn
primer: ASE Technology (NYSE: ASX) leads global chip packaging with ~27–28% share and >$4.0B in 2026 AI LEAP sales. Yet 9M 2026 free cash flow hit -NT$115.9B, debt jumped 54% to NT$406.5B, and U.S. export rules tightened on Nov 18. On Nov 20, shares fell 13.84% to $26.27 in Stage 4—breaking our $29.25 hard stop—while our reconciled FY2027E bridge ($1.22 EPS at 13.5x) puts Base fair value at $16.47. We reject new buys (TIER_0), sell all 82 Schwab shares immediately, and hold 100% of proceeds in USD cash.
holding_rationale: The $26.27 close broke our $29.25 hard stop by 10.2% on 2.13x volume. ASX now sits in Stage 4 inside a weak market with 10 index distribution days. Selling all 82 shares cuts 8.72% of effective beta exposure from a crowded chip cluster. It locks in a small loss and frees $2,154.14 in safe cash.

gate_exceptions: Browser tool note: macOS Chrome tabs for TheWrap, Robinhood, and TradingView are unavailable in this Linux container. We used public TradingView, Finviz, and yfinance data instead, while WeasyPrint built the PDF book cleanly.

Stage label split: The facts file marks ASX as Stage 1 because price ($26.27) sits near its 63-day low ($26.06). Our snapshot tool marks STAGE_4 because price fell 13.84% on 2.13x volume and sits 23.7% below its 200-day average ($34.43). We follow the stricter STAGE_4 rule.

Stale filing dates (EXCEPTION AS-OF): Three ASX items in the research file come from the FY2025 Form 20-F dated 2026-04-01. That report is 233 days old, but it is the newest annual filing with top-client, substrate, and country asset footnotes (expected cure date: ~2027-04-01 upon FY2026 Form 20-F filing). Other older baseline rows in the shared US file carry the same filing note.
